in_marathi.name: Arpit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arpit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arpit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arpita’ which means ‘divine, precious, offered, dedicated’. In Hindu mythology, Arpit is a name given to gods and goddesses, symbolizing their divine presence and preciousness. It is also used as a personal name, signifying the bearer's connection to the divine.
